title: Analysis code and de-identified aggregate results for: A heterogeneous deep-learning ensemble for assistive 11-class classification of kidney disease on transmission electron microscopy
description: Preprocessing, person-level splitting with a leakage guard, backbone training, test-time augmentation, decision fusion, calibration, ablation, referral and Grad-CAM code, together with the de-identified aggregate tables behind the figures and tables of the accompanying Scientific Reports submission. Contains no raw/source electron microscopy images, no model weights, no prediction tensors, and no patient or biopsy archive numbers. Source-microscopy content in the publication figures is limited to visually reviewed, de-identified Grad-CAM panels.
